name: INCHAR
note: input char; read ~41x, written by GETKEY; consts CR/'0'/'A'

name: PARTYCNT
note: party size; most-read global (86x); loop bound "0..PARTYCNT-1"

name: CACHE_LRU
note: MRU list head for the string cache; STRINIT:=NIL, GETSTR prepends

name: BACKGND
note: main screen window record; taken by-ref 54x; alloc in STRINIT

name: WINDOW1
note: secondary window ptr; alloc in STRINIT

name: CACHEBL
note: scenario block currently in IOCACHE; STRINIT:=-1 (Apple word 4)

name: KRNBLOCK
note: first volume block of ASCII.KRN (GetStr "SoffSet"); set by LOADSTRTREE

name: SCNTOCBL
note: first volume block of SCENARIO.DATA; GETREC adds it to DSKBLOCK (Apple word 5)

name: STR_ROOT
note: GETSTR: strTree root node index (= strTree[0].word[4])

name: HIRES400
note: boolean: 400-line vs 200-line screen mode (picks 200/400 file prefix)

name: HAS_EXTRAM
note: boolean: extended RAM available (enables extra caches)

name: CHARDISK
note: ARRAY[0..5] OF INTEGER - roster slot index per party member (Apple word 68)

name: GBUF
note: shared scratch string buffer; taken by-ref by 45 procs, all segments

name: CHARACTR
note: party ARRAY[0..5] OF TCHAR, 104 words each (p-code confirmed via ROLLER GETCHARC); Apple word 74 + 289

name: SCNTOC_RECSIZE
note: SCNTOC+37: record byte size per type [8]

name: IOCACHE
note: 1024-byte scenario block buffer (512 words); Apple word 950 + 289

name: CHARSET
note: 64 x TCHRIMAG font-image cache (256 words); Apple word 1462 + 289
